description: Search the community's AI workflows offline, and rank them by week - two things the site's own API cannot do.

tools.name: comments_list
tools.description: List comments on a workflow post. Required: post_id. Optional: cursor. Returns array of Comment.

tools.name: leaderboard_list
tools.description: This week's top contributors by points (server always returns the weekly window).

tools.name: posts_list
tools.description: List community workflow posts with server-side filters. Optional: sort (default: new), type, query (plus 5 more). Returns array of Post.

params.name: sort
params.description: Ranking: new (default, complete + stable paging), top, or recommended. Note: recommended is personalised and omits ~13% of posts, so it is a poor choice for sync.

params.name: type
params.description: Post type: workflow, question, or win

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text search across titles and bodies (server-side, semantic)

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter to a single tag slug, e.g. aimemory

params.name: tool
params.description: Filter to workflows using a tool slug, e.g. claude-code (see: rundown-pp-cli tools)

params.name: industry
params.description: Filter to an industry slug, e.g. software-technology

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: List every tool slug the community can tag a workflow with. Returns array of Tool.

novel_features.name: Time-windowed top workflows
novel_features.description: Rank the highest-upvoted workflows inside a time window like 7d or 30d.

novel_features.name: Use-case finder
novel_features.description: Answer 'are there any workflows for X' by blending the server's semantic search with local full-text search, then ranking by upvotes.

novel_features.name: Full workflow reader
novel_features.description: Print one workflow in full - body, tools, industries, author and comments - in a single call.

novel_features.name: Community digest
novel_features.description: Summarise a time window: how many workflows landed, the top posts, the most-used tools and the busiest authors.

novel_features.name: Tool adoption ranking
novel_features.description: Rank AI tools by how often they appear in workflows and by the upvotes those workflows earned.

novel_features.name: Tool co-occurrence stacks
novel_features.description: Show which other tools appear alongside a given tool, so you can see the stacks people really run.
